title: Global-to-local hardware opportunity universe — discovery hypotheses, not validated supply gaps
scope: Indonesia and Taiwan test markets; upstream global products and China/Asia/Taiwan supply capabilities
limitations: No concept has established a local supply shortfall, verified buyer, independent completed sale, actual landed cost, commercial permission, tested hardware, or unit profit. Section-source URLs signal sector activity only, not validity of individual concept.

scoring_policy.no_numeric_scores_until: buyer evidence + exact comparable market offers + full landed cost + HS engineering route + permission
scoring_policy.minimum_evidence_for_opportunity_claim: Two independent dated local competing offers or demonstrable shortage, real buyer evidence, function-matched global reference, real all-in cost/qualification and clear feasible route
scoring_policy.prohibition: Never infer demand from crowdfunding alone or infer unsupplied from a missing search result; never infer margin from retail minus BOM.
